title: Army adapting NHI-derived electro-optic cloaking to combat vehicles

tellings.quote: There have been instances in the early 2000s in which specifically the army uh was interested in adapting electrooptic cloaking to next generation combat vehicle.

plain: In the early 2000s the US Army is said to have wanted to put electro-optic cloaking, a way of hiding things from sight with light and electronics, on its next generation of combat vehicles. The story holds that the cloaking came from studying technology of non-human origin. UAPGerb, a researcher known by that online name, passes this on from someone he spoke with. If true, technology taken from non-human craft would be making its way into ordinary military vehicles.
